original_value: We present a new spatio-temporal incentive-based approach to achieve a geographically balanced coverage of crowdsourced services. The proposed approach is based on a new spatio-temporal incentive model that considers multiple parameters including location entropy, time of day, and spatio-temporal density to encourage the participation of crowdsourced service providers. We present a greedy network flow algorithm that offers incentives to redistribute crowdsourced service providers to improve the crowdsourced coverage balance within an area. A novel participation probability model is also introduced to estimate the expected number of crowdsourced service providers’ movement based on spatio-temporal features. Experimental results validate the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

result.paraphrase: We introduce a new spatio-temporal incentive-based method for achieving geographically balanced crowdsourced service coverage. The approach relies on a spatio-temporal incentive model that uses several factors, including location entropy, time of day, and spatio-temporal density, to encourage crowdsourced service providers to participate. We also present a greedy network flow algorithm that assigns incentives to redistribute providers and improve coverage balance within an area. In addition, a novel participation probability model estimates the expected movement of crowdsourced service providers from spatio-temporal features. Experimental results confirm the proposed approach is efficient and effective.
